description: Add ten kinds of static street furniture on the sidewalks. Placement rules are in src/world/furniture-layout.js (pure JS, no three import, so the harness can test it on the real town). Meshes are built in src/world/street-furniture.js as instanced meshes through addInstanced. Placement uses its own seeded generator and never calls rand(), so the town, trees, and bushes do not move. Non-blocking by default. Switch: STREET_FURNITURE_COLLISION in src/core/world.js. Targets: lamps 120, benches 60, trash bins 90, bus shelters 12, mailboxes 60, newspaper stands 40, vending machines 30, electrical boxes 50, fire hydrants 40, advertising boards 40. Depends on FEAT-001 (harness must exist and environment.js must already contain the new traffic light code).
steps: In src/core/world.js add export const SIDEWALK_HEIGHT = 0.15 after SIDEWALK_WIDTH (line 8), export const sidewalkFixtures = [] and export const STREET_FURNITURE_COLLISION = false with a one-line comment after ROADSIDE_BARRIER_COLLISION (line 12). In src/world/environment.js remove const SIDEWALK_HEIGHT (line 14), import SIDEWALK_HEIGHT and sidewalkFixtures from ../core/world.js, and push {x, z} for each street lamp pole in addStreetLamps and for each junction pole (poleX, poleZ) in addTrafficLights.

In src/core/primitives.js change addInstanced (line 21) to take an optional 5th parameter colors = null. When colors is set, call mesh.setColorAt(i, colors[i]) per instance. Keep the other behavior unchanged.

Create src/world/furniture-layout.js. Export FURNITURE_TYPES (the ten types with id, fl, fw, v, gap, target, colors as hex arrays or null; values in the feature description and plan.md Placement rules) and layoutFurniture(lots). Use a mulberry32 generator seeded 20240601 defined in this file. Constants: SIDE_CLEAR 0.3, CROSS_CLEAR SIDEWALK_WIDTH + 2, LOT_CLEAR 3, FIXTURE_CLEAR 1.5, GAP_CLEAR 0.3, JITTER 0.15, ATTEMPTS_PER_TARGET 400. For each type in table order, try up to target * 400 random candidates: street index, side sd in {-1, 1}, along t in [-WORLD_LIMIT, WORLD_LIMIT], jittered v; across = offset + sd * (halfWidth + v). Build the world rect (alongX: x from t, z from across; otherwise swapped). Reject when: v - fw/2 < SIDE_CLEAR or v + fw/2 > SIDEWALK_WIDTH - SIDE_CLEAR; the along range enters a crossing street's offset +/- (halfWidth + CROSS_CLEAR); the rect grown by LOT_CLEAR along the street overlaps a lot; the rect grown by FIXTURE_CLEAR contains a fixture point; same type, same street and side, and |dt| < gap; or the rect grown by GAP_CLEAR overlaps a placed rect. Accept: {type, x, z, rotY, color, rect, si, sd, t}; rotY = sd > 0 ? 0 : PI on alongX streets and sd > 0 ? PI/2 : -PI/2 otherwise; color = random palette index or -1. Stop at target. No rand() calls.

Create src/world/street-furniture.js. Import three, addInstanced, matrixAt, SIDEWALK_HEIGHT, STREET_FURNITURE_COLLISION, obstacles, FURNITURE_TYPES, layoutFurniture. Define a PARTS map: each type's parts from plan.md item 6 (geo box or cyl, offset [lx, ly, lz] with lz away from the road, size, color hex or tint true). For each placement and part: px = p.x + lx*cos(rotY) + lz*sin(rotY), pz = p.z - lx*sin(rotY) + lz*cos(rotY), y = SIDEWALK_HEIGHT + ly, matrix = matrixAt(px, y, pz, sx, sy, sz, rotY). Cylinder unit geometry: CylinderGeometry(0.5, 0.5, 1, 12). Box unit geometry: BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1). Tinted parts: white material plus instance colors new THREE.Color(FURNITURE_TYPES colors[p.color]). Other parts: material cached by hex. Export addStreetFurniture(scene, lots): one addInstanced per part; if STREET_FURNITURE_COLLISION is true, push {box: p.rect} to obstacles for each placement; return per-type counts.
In src/main.js add addStreetFurniture to an import from ./world/street-furniture.js, and call addStreetFurniture(scene, lots); right after addRoadEdges(scene, lots); (line 57), before addTrees.
Update README.md: add the two new files under ## Files, and add the STREET_FURNITURE_COLLISION switch note to the src/core/world.js line.
Run the harness and fix any violation the harness reports, in the files this FEAT owns.
acceptance_criteria: node $env:TEMP\furn-check\check.mjs exits 0 and reports zero violations of: road overlap, sidewalk band, crossing clearance, lot clearance, fixture clearance, and overlap between objects.
The harness prints counts for all ten types. Each count equals its target, or the shortfall is printed and explained in findings.
The lot JSON and obstacle count still match baseline.json (switch off adds no obstacle; town layout unchanged).
STREET_FURNITURE_COLLISION exists in src/core/world.js with value false.
node --check passes for every changed .js file in the harness copy.
verification: node $env:TEMP\furn-check\check.mjs (exit 0, zero violations, per-type counts printed)
node --check on each changed .js file inside $env:TEMP\furn-check\src
Browser check by a person: furniture appears on the sidewalks on both sides of every street, none on the road, none in parking bays, none in front of lots or at crossings.
findings: Per-type counts from check.mjs: streetLamp 120 of 120, bench 60 of 60, trashBin 90 of 90, busShelter 12 of 12, mailbox 60 of 60, newspaperStand 40 of 40, vendingMachine 30 of 30, electricalBox 50 of 50, fireHydrant 40 of 40, adBoard 40 of 40. Total 542. No shortfall against any target. Commands run: (1) node $env:TEMP\furn-check\check.mjs: exit 0, lots 125 and obstacles 341 (both match baseline.json), violations 0. (2) node --check on src/core/world.js, src/core/primitives.js, src/world/environment.js, src/main.js, src/world/furniture-layout.js and src/world/street-furniture.js in the harness copy: all exit 0. (3) grep for rand( in furniture-layout.js and street-furniture.js: no calls (one doc comment names rand()). Files changed: src/core/world.js (SIDEWALK_HEIGHT, STREET_FURNITURE_COLLISION = false, sidewalkFixtures), src/core/primitives.js (optional colors parameter on addInstanced), src/world/environment.js (SIDEWALK_HEIGHT moved out, fixture positions pushed for lamps and traffic light poles), src/world/furniture-layout.js (new), src/world/street-furniture.js (new), src/main.js (import and call after addRoadEdges), README.md (file list and switch note). The harness check.mjs was extended with the furniture rule checks from plan item 8 (outside the repo). Deviation from plan text: the lot clearance grows the footprint on both axes, not only along the street. Lots start 2.5 m off the curb and footprints stay inside the sidewalk band, so an along-street-only growth never overlaps a lot and would allow furniture in front of lots. Items for a person to check in the browser: vending machine front panel (lz -0.345) and newspaper stand window (lz -0.26) sit on the road-facing side per the plan.md part table, so they may need to move to the sidewalk side. Index note: the changes are unstaged on top of earlier staged changes in README.md, primitives.js, world.js, main.js and environment.js. The two new files are untracked. Nothing was staged or committed by this step. Finding (4) resolved by user decision KEEP THE FRONT FACES: vending machine and newspaper stand fronts are unchanged.
